DMA Industries/ Brake Best Select - Fitment Confirmation: We received feedback from a store regarding DMA Brake Best Select Brake Pad Wear sensor part number 20179. The team stated the customer has issues at time of installation where the customer mentioned the length of the harness was too short and the connector was not the same as the OE wear sensor (34356870349). An ACES snippet from the most recent ACES delivery shows 20179 cataloged to fit the 2022 BMW 330i xDrive.
response: This is a catalog issue. We currently have this part cataloged for a 330i xDrive Base for the 2017–2024 year ranges. Based on market research and drawing confirmations, the part should be cataloged strictly for the 2017–2018 year range for that specific application and for 2019 for the 330i GT xDrive. For 2019 and later 330i xDrive models, other aftermarket parts have a longer extended length; DMA will need to develop a new part number to cover 2019–2026.
